title: The Browser Company says it will shut down its Arc browser on December 22, launched in 2023, shifting attention to its AI-focused Dia browser, launched in 2025 (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: The Browser Company says it will shut down its Arc browser on December 22, launched in 2023, shifting attention to its AI-focused Dia browser, launched in 2025 — New feature development for the innovative web browser ended last year. Now The Browser Company is telling users to try Dia, Arc's replacement.
